recurringPatterns.pattern: 'establishes X but cannot establish Y' formula applied to nearly every piece of evidence
instances: Those facts establish that a violent episode affected a group...
Its survival establishes that a monument was made and displayed... It does not establish how many soldiers died

recurringPatterns.pattern: 'Its value lies in…' tag sentence closing out cases
instances: Their value lies in the different ways each episode entered the archaeological record.
Its value lies in the institutional change it records...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Chapter-final paired antithesis 'expanded where… narrowed where…'
instances: Violence expanded where moral claims joined command...; it narrowed where recognised procedures...
It narrowed where repeated exchange, credible enforcement, and negotiated status made predation more costly...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Anti-ranking disclaimer as a moral reflex
instances: They do not arrange societies on a ladder from savage to civilised.
El Salvador's homicide statistics describe a different distribution of danger...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Two-case comparison scaffold declaring incommensurability, near-identical chapter architecture
instances: Talheim gives bodily evidence... Ely gives an administrative description...
One source compresses an atrocity into narrative; the other reveals a commercial town...

summary: Rigorous history with a coherent thesis; structural failure: every chapter runs the same machine; voice grey and impersonal; relentless symmetrical hedging drains momentum.
